# Northvale Transit Fare Table (2026)

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software evaluation; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Fares

A single ride costs 2.80 euros. A day pass costs 8.00 euros. A monthly pass costs 72 euros.

## 2 Validity of tickets

A single ride ticket is valid for 120 minutes after validation.

## 3 Changes in 2026

The 2026 fare table raised the single ride fare from 2.40 euros to 2.80 euros and extended single ride validity from 90 to 120 minutes.
